memory.bench.customers (join orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id to get the customer's region)

```sql
SELECT c.region AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY c.region
```
